question: What was the name of the mascot of the Paralympics - 2020 ?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Someity__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Name of the Mascot Paralympic-2020 was **Someity.**
 
• Someity's name also echoes the English phrase** "so mighty".**
 
• The **Mascots **financially helped the **Tokyo Olympic Games** through merchandising and licensing deals.
 
• **Someity** is named upon someiyoshino, a type of cherry blossom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **There are currently 28 Paralympic sports sanctioned by the IPC: 22 summers and six winters.**
 
• **Some of the Paralympic games are mentioned below:**__
 __
 
• **​**__Archery.
 
• Badminton.
 
• Blind football.
 
• Boccia.
 
• Canoe.
 
• Cycling.
 
• Equestrian.
 
• Goalball.
